---
title: "Contributing with AI agents"
description: "How AI coding agents and people share the same repository rules, reviews and release path."
updatedAt: '2026-10-31'
---

AI coding agents contribute to Tuturuuu under the same rules as people. The
repository's root `AGENTS.md` is the single source for those rules; this page
summarizes what that means for a contributor, human or agent.

## Principles

- **One set of rules.** Agents follow the conventions in
  [Git conventions](/build/development-tools/git-conventions),
  [Pre-push checks](/build/development-tools/pre-push-checks) and
  [Documenting](/build/development-tools/documenting). An agent's change is
  reviewed like any other change.
- **Small, isolated changes.** Work happens on its own branch or worktree and is
  published as a normal pull request; see
  [Stacked pull requests](/build/development-tools/stacked-pull-requests) for
  larger changes.
- **Verify locally first.** Run the focused checks for the area you changed and
  record the commands and results in the pull request.
- **Docs ship with code.** A feature pull request updates the matching docs
  page, or says why no documentation is needed.
- **No secrets in the repository.** Never commit tokens, keys, credentials or
  rendered environment dumps, and never paste them into docs, issues or pull
  requests. See [Deployment configuration](/build/devops/deployment-configuration).
- **Sensitive areas get a security review.** Changes to authentication,
  authorization, data protection, billing or infrastructure are reviewed by a
  human code owner before merge; see [Code owners](/build/devops/code-owners).
- **Stay inside the active runtime.** Follow the
  [active runtime map](/build/devops/active-runtime) and do not resume paused
  runtimes unless a maintainer asks.

## Where to start

New contributors can begin with [Development](/build/development-tools/development),
[Without Docker](/build/development-tools/without-docker) and the
[monorepo architecture](/build/development-tools/monorepo-architecture).
